question: Where was the Durand Cup Tournament started in India in 1888?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shimla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Durand Cup is one of the oldest football tournaments in the world and the oldest in Asia.
 
• It was started in the year 1888 in Shimla, India.
 
• The tournament was initially a military affair, organized by then India's Foreign Secretary, Mortimer Durand.
 
• Over the years, it has grown to become a prestigious event in Indian football, with clubs from across the country participating.</
